topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I just found out that the little Italian place down the street is shutting down. It’s been there for as long as I can remember, and every time I walked through the door, it felt like home. I mean, their lasagna? It was like a piece of heaven. I’ve been trying to think of reasons to go there more often in the past few weeks, anything to savor those last moments. I’m not sure what I’ll do without it. Maybe I should go there one last time, just to say goodbye properly. It’s the least I can do after all the meals they’ve given me.
